mapper.sql: id, division_id, batch_code, batch_name, batch_version, batch_status, active_unique_key, result_source, result_remark, random_seed, roster_version_id, unassigned_policy, unassigned_remark, confirmed_by, confirmed_time, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time, is_delete
mapper.select: select from basket_personal_draw_batch where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
select from basket_personal_draw_batch where division_id = #{divisionId} and is_delete = 0 and active_unique_key is not null limit 1
select coalesce(max(batch_version), 0) + 1 from basket_personal_draw_batch where division_id = #{divisionId}

select b.id as draw_batch_id, b.division_id, d.division_name, b.batch_code, b.batch_name, b.batch_version, b.batch_status, b.result_source, b.result_remark, b.unassigned_policy, b.confirmed_time, b.create_time from basket_personal_draw_batch b left join basket_division d on d.id = b.division_id and d.is_delete = 0 where b.is_delete = 0 and b.division_id = #{divisionId} and b.batch_status = #{batchStatus} order by b.batch_version desc, b.id desc
mapper.update:
update basket_personal_draw_batch
batch_status = #{batchStatus}, active_unique_key = #{activeUniqueKey}, result_source = #{resultSource}, result_remark = #{resultRemark}, random_seed = #{randomSeed}, roster_version_id = #{rosterVersionId}, unassigned_policy = #{unassignedPolicy}, unassigned_remark = #{unassignedRemark}, confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, confirmed_time = #{confirmedTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now()
where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
update basket_personal_draw_batch set is_delete = 1, active_unique_key = null, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
update basket_personal_draw_batch set active_unique_key = null, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0

update basket_personal_draw_batch set batch_status = 'LOCKED', roster_version_id = #{rosterVersionId}, confirmed_by = #{operatorId}, confirmed_time = now(), update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0 and batch_status in ('DRAFT', 'GENERATED', 'ADJUSTING', 'CONFIRMED')
